thread:
rachel: quick incident note 

we saw a GPU fleet warmup regression after the eu-fw SNI rule landed. nodes stalled at kubelet join waiting for keystore decrypts. warmup added ~9m per node.
tom: timeline? which rule specifically?
priyanka: SNI inspect + egress deny to temporary bucket ranges. auditshipper calls to keystore s3 were getting rewritten and produced many short-lived connections. conntrack hit ~70k on the NAT instance.
rachel: sample log: `auditshipper: PutObject failed: dial tcp 10.34.2.19:443: i/o timeout`
ops-bot: infra-canary: fw-roll-2026-04 flagged 504s for auditshipper in eu-west at 07:11 UTC.
tom: mitigation applied: - add ephemeral SG allow for auditshipper -> keystore S3 IPs, - enable privatelink to keystore proxy, - reduce warmup audit sampling to 10%.
priyanka: also bumped conntrack max as an emergency: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` but that's temporary.
rachel: action items: 1) make privatelink default for keystore in eu, 2) add conntrack-pressure alarm at 50k, 3) add firewall preflight to simulate flow counts, 4) set default warmup sampling to 0.1.
tom: cost note: NATGW egress spiked during the window; privatelink preferred for sustained traffic. I'll add numbers to the incident doc.
ops-bot: incident-created INC-20260405-19. Keep updates in this thread.
